conclusions.generic: Ideal24 V already delivers unclipped demand;48 V does not alter response. Peak generic requested voltage19.5488712 V, current2.9125452 A.

conclusions.linearStageHeadroom: For the same hot coil at a physical24 V supply with hypothetical4/5 V linear-stage loss, effective20/19 V cases fail: worst true-normal errors2.8823858/5.7156655 N.36 V with verified31 V effective output is the supported prototype envelope. This does not claim aTA11524 V output specification.

failureInterpretation: All four19/20 V hot-coil envelope failures complete0–4 s with contact maintained and no travel-stop hit. Startup and pre-bump force errors stay below0.151 N; failures occur during the sharp bump. The hot steady holding voltage is18.2295 V, leaving insufficient dynamic current-regulation headroom.
